title: Dungeon Dive T-Shirts are Here!
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lOciy5N92Lg

Daniel (@dungeondive) announces that Dungeon Dive shirts exist, sold through TeePublic.

The classic logo design is by Robert Lemon of Dark Venture — the same designer whose game the channel gave away two years earlier. The second design is new, by Jason Glover of Iron Helm, and Daniel is plainly delighted with it: a retro-leaning logo worked into a larger design, shown on screen during the video. More artists are on the list to approach.

The range runs past t-shirts to baseball jerseys, hoodies and mugs. Daniel spent a little extra on a premium shirt for himself and reports the material is good, with secondhand confirmation from Facebook group members who bought the jersey-style ones.

What comes through is the principle rather than the merchandise. Daniel says he wants the merch to be special to viewers of the Dungeon Dive specifically, which means building it around the things this audience actually likes — which, on this channel, mostly means good art by designers the viewers already know by name. The shirts double as a small showcase for people whose games have been on the table here.

----

Channel merch built around artists the audience already follows, rather than a wordmark on a blank tee. Does that change what the shirt is for?
